function.name: search_directory_index
function.description: Explores, maps, or searches the active workspace directory. Run this tool with NO query (or null) if you are lost, need to understand the project structure, or want to locate files; this returns the entire recursive directory tree, listing all files, subdirectories, and lightweight code preview snippets. If you know what you are looking for, provide a query to filter files and paths by keyword.

query.description: The keyword, filename, folder name, or file extension to search for. OPTIONAL: Leave this completely empty or null to retrieve the entire project layout and map out the codebase.
